A qualified mental-health professional must review, rewrite or replace each one before it is approved. See docs/review-needed.md R1.

en.title: Five senses
en.summary: Notice what is around you, one sense at a time.
steps: Look around and name five things you can see.
Notice four things you can touch, and how each one feels.
Listen for three sounds, near or far.
Notice two things you can smell.
Notice one thing you can taste, or take a sip of water.

en.title: Slow breathing
en.summary: Breathe in for four, out for six. Stop whenever you like.
steps: Sit or stand in a way that feels steady.
Breathe in through your nose while the light grows.
Breathe out slowly while it shrinks.
If you feel light-headed, stop and breathe normally.

en.title: Three lines
en.summary: Write three short lines about today, on paper or anywhere private.
steps: Write one line about something that happened today.
Write one line about how it felt.
Write one line about something you would like tomorrow.
Keep it or throw it away. Nothing you write is saved in this app.

en.title: One small step
en.summary: Pick one thing that feels too big and find its first ten minutes.
steps: Name one task that is on your mind.
Ask: what is the first part I could do in ten minutes?
Decide when you will do that part.
Stop there. The rest can wait until that part is done.

en.title: Stretch and stand
en.summary: A short, gentle movement break. Skip anything that is uncomfortable.
steps: Stand up, or sit tall if standing is not comfortable.
Roll your shoulders back slowly a few times.
Reach both arms up, then let them drop.
Walk to a window or a door and back.

en.title: Screens down
en.summary: A simple routine for the last few minutes before sleep.
steps: Put your phone somewhere you cannot reach from bed.
Dim the lights if you can.
Get tomorrow's first thing ready, such as clothes or a bag.
Lie down and let your breathing slow on its own.
